training_budget: Two algorithms, three candidates each, two scenarios, two paired seeds = 24 attempts. No retries, replacements, extra tuning or formal flights.
validation_budget: After deterministic selection, two algorithms x two scenarios x three new paired seeds = 12 attempts. Separate exact-source freeze before launch; no reselection from validation.
pilot_proposal: 18 separate attempts: heading, figure8+force, figure8+mass x two selected algorithms x three paired seeds. Not enabled by this training entry. Freeze physical implementation, exact list and source before any launch. Current continuous V08 authority does not authorize formal holdout.
formal_budget: Core200 only: hover,figure8,heading,force,mass x PID/XY ESTA x20 paired seeds. DIV1. No optional DIV2/4 inclusion and no formal execution in V08.
selection: All four training runs per candidate must meet unchanged safety/logging/constraint gates. Equal-weight mean across four runs of J=XYmeanRMSE/0.02 + 0.1*XYmeanCorrectionTVperSecond/1.0. Failure penalty1000000 and immediate batch stop; incomplete/failed candidates cannot win. Ties within1e-12 choose lower index. No data-dependent early stop except mandatory safety/logging rejection.

timing: Original V07 protocol07 launcher/checks: 1x, restart/preheat30s, audited2.5m handoff,90..92s observation with12s settling and64s scoring/two32s loops, land/disarm/healthtail. Actual100Hz measured not assumed. No controller production changes.

Any mandatory failure stops batch. Validation additionally original paired developmental velocity/position/yaw gates. Training does not demand one algorithm beat another candidate.
randomness: Only IMU engine seeded. All candidates reuse each paired training seed; not 24 independent draws. No old M10/V04..V07 data used as unseen holdout. GPS/barometer/magnetometer and host scheduling not independently seeded. Freeze historical audit, verifyfirst5000 innovations per sharedseed and crossseed differences.
storage: V07 private tmpfs recording and strict durable exclusive SHA/fsync archival reused. For THIS V08 batch only, after shutdown and all archives verified, remove redundant tmpfs copies to avoid capacity exhaustion; durable original byte streams stay in external run directories. Never touch pre-existing V07 roots. No deletion of failed run archives. Partial/error archive retains RAM source.
stop: No push, no hardware, no ISTA, no V09. First failure stops this finite protocol, records all data; continuous authority is not permission to relax gates, auto-retry or add tuning chances. Fix only evidenced in-scope implementation defects with separate version/freeze if necessary.
